name: rust-fetch-workspace
description: Development workspace for the rust-fetch npm package (published from wasm-module/pkg)

scripts.build: cd wasm-module && wasm-pack build --release --target web && node ../scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:js
scripts.test:js: node --test wasm-module/js/test/client.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/client-js.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/node-transport.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/node-transport-js.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/browser-transport.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/websocket.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/events.test.mjs wasm-module/js/test/package.test.mjs
